title: The Real Cost of Cruises | Patriot Act with Hasan Minhaj | Netflix
summary: An episode of Patriot Act with Hasan Minhaj on the cruise industry. It looks at worker exploitation, safety shortcuts, and how cruise lines sweep crime at sea under the rug.
why: Commenters point to it when discussing the lax regulation of cruise ships and flags of convenience.

quote.text: Hasan Minhaj did an interesting episode about cruise ships recently on "Patriot Act" if you're interested
